dependencyOrder.work: After approval only: record exact accepted Spec/Plan3, source baseline, Task ownership, immutable case/oracle versions and bounded outputs; reobserve current target/base without altering other sessions.
Implementation worker builds canonical quality API/CLI and direct tests; scenario worker prepares independent complex fixtures/oracles/diagnosis controls under separate Task worktree/branch.

Join the agreed API with scenario outputs; Root integrates exact reviewed deltas and pins. Run appropriate package/scenario checks in parallel only where independent; source/provider/owner-generation ordering stays serial.
Freeze candidate commit/tree, independently review source and evidence, resolve findings and rerun affected checks. Do not review a moving target or reuse a different tree's approval.

Verify frozen exact head/base; push only the owned reviewed source branch with no PR yet; publish independent immutable review evidence and authenticated status for that remotely present SHA; recheck current head/base/findings/required checks; then open the scoped PR.

panes.root: Current user-facing pane retains Lead/Orchestrator purpose, decisions, IDs, dependency graph, integration, approval boundaries and PR.
panes.implementation: One native worker pane in its isolated Task worktree/branch; tightly coupled code+direct tests grouped.
panes.scenario: One native worker pane in its isolated Task worktree/branch; independent source-grounded scenarios and verification controls.
panes.review: One separate reviewer pane after immutable candidate freeze; no author self-review.
panes.efficiency: Start only useful panes; no status-only workers, unrelated focus/closure or extra pane count. Read back current live IDs before control; native loops/tools/profiles/credentials stay native.

verification: Quality transition/control tests including both-arm failures, missing evidence, duplicate/version/consumer mismatch and non-authorizing results.
Actual runSuite/evaluateUnit-produced result compatibility, not only handwritten result fixtures.
Selected complex context/history/recovery/source-closure/Git semantic integration/CI incident offline oracles.
bun run check:handoff, check:imports, affected package checks, check:quality and exact check:source/provider closure.
All affected consumer integration paths; distinguish source/adapter fixtures, actual native consumption and owner activation.
Final head/tree/exact findings and current required checks before PR.
content.nativeQualificationBoundary: No inherited or new model-evaluation budget is implied. Existing source and adapter integration can be tested locally. Any actual native evaluation/activation needed for an E2E claim requires its own current owner admission; keep it explicitly incomplete and never relabel a fixture as native behavior. PR scope/claims must match the evidence. If an affected native consumer cannot be qualified without separately unapproved effects/admission, keep that criterion explicitly pending; the PR remains draft for that missing qualification and never claims actual native E2E completion.
